title: DECISION: Single-pass FIPS-only lookup — no silent downgrade
description: crypto2dev_lookup_algo() uses a single pass through the provider list with a fips_mode filter (skip non-FIPS providers when fips_provider_count > 0). There is NO fallback to non-FIPS providers. A two-pass design — try FIPS first, fall back to non-FIPS if no FIPS provider handles the algo — would enable silent algorithm downgrade to unvalidated crypto. An algorithm not served by any FIPS provider returns -ENOENT with an explanatory log message. A reviewer who suggests 'try non-FIPS as fallback for compatibility' is suggesting a CMVP compliance violation.
close_reason: Design decision recorded; no code change needed.
